name: shead45
caption:
TRADED ON DRAFT NIGHT 🎮🏀 Sacramento drafted him. Traded him to us the same night.

• 2024 draft: #45 to Sacramento, traded to us that night
• College: first player ever named Big 12 Player and Defensive Player of the Year in the same season
• Rookie year: 307 assists, #2 among rookies in our history
• 2025-26: all 82 games. Oct 2026: 3-year extension
• First 12 games this season: 6.8 APG, mostly off the bench, 16 assists at Milwaukee

Should he start? 👇

beats.head: TRADED ON DRAFT NIGHT
beats.name: SHEAD
beats.vo: Sacramento drafted Jamal Shead forty-fifth. That same night, he was traded to us.
beats.dlg: PICK 45 BY SACRAMENTO...|TRADED TO US THAT NIGHT.

beats.head: ROOKIE YEAR
beats.name: SHEAD
beats.vo: As a rookie: three hundred seven assists. Second most by a rookie in our history.
beats.dlg: ROOKIE: 307 ASSISTS.|#2 ROOKIE IN OUR HISTORY.

beats.head: IRON MAN
beats.name: SHEAD
beats.vo: Last season he played all eighty-two games. This fall, we gave him a three-year extension.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: SHEAD
beats.vo: Through twelve games this season: six point eight assists a night, mostly off the bench, and sixteen in our win at Milwaukee.
beats.dlg: FIRST 12 GAMES: 6.8 APG.|16 ASSISTS AT MILWAUKEE.

beats.head: SHOULD HE START?
beats.vo: Pick forty-five. Should he be our starter? Comment below.

facts.claim: 2024 NBA draft: Shead selected #45 (45th overall) by Sacramento and traded on draft night to Toronto; 2023-24: Big 12 Player of the Year and Defensive Player of the Year, the first player to win both in the same season; rookie year 307 assists, #2 (second) among rookies in franchise history; played all 82 games in 2025-26 (started 12); October 1, 2026: 3-year contract extension
